label: Unemployment rate
reliability_criteria: Canonical tier = Eurostat une_rt_a pinned age=Y15-74/unit=PC_ACT/ sex=T (the LFS questionnaire's own broadest band — the codelist carries no TOTAL; unit PC_ACT is the rate's own denominator, not PC_POP; 1-decimal as published), 38 geos (EU + EFTA + Western Balkans + Turkiye; no UK — post-Brexit the door stopped carrying it), 2003-2025, 635 valued cells, the collector's b/d flags transported as-reported on quality_code (d on FR and ES 2021-2025: the 2021 LFS questionnaire redesign — a definitional seam the connector surfaces, not a geo seam; b = break in series; no provisional codes in this dataset). Witness tier = the WB national-estimate line, 208 countries 1990-2025, 0-3 decimals as printed. Root pair eurostat_lfs/ilo_lfs: same underlying national surveys, one harmonization step apart — on the co-covered core they print the same rates to rounding (FR 2015: 10.4 vs 10.354), and the seams the pair displays (FR 2024 7.436 vs 7.4 rounding; DE 2005 11.193 on the witness vs ABSENT on the collector) read as two doors, never a contradiction.

notes:
THE PINS ARE THE INDICATOR (verified live before any wiring): age Y15-74 (the codelist's seven bands carry NO TOTAL — a query for it soft-misses with HTTP 200 and an empty value object; Y15-74 is the LFS's own labour-force window and the de-facto total rate), unit PC_ACT (percentage of the labour force — the rate's denominator; PC_POP prints the wrong denominator, FR 2015 = 6.6), sex T (the both-sexes rate; the M/F splits exist — FR M 2015 = 10.8, F = 9.9 — the unwired sex doors, one ref away each), freq A only (the monthly companion une_rt_m is refused: annualising monthly data is a derivation).
THE COVERAGE CLIFF (the honest shape, documented per-geo by the probe): FR alone runs 2003-2025 (23 points, the only full-length series); every other EU geo + IS/NO/TR/MK start 2009; SE 2005, CH and RS 2010; BA starts 2021; ME (Montenegro) STOPS AT 2020. Germany 1991-2008 lives only on the witness (DEU 1991 = 5.316, DEU 2005 = 11.193 — the EU-LFS 15+ rate, ~3pp above the 2010s Y15-74 prints of the same economy: the witness's own age-base and methodology seam, displayed by the divergence view and explained by the root pair). The interwar prints of L'invention de l'Europe (Austria 1930-34) are book tables — territory curated, not a living wire; this indicator's history starts 1990 on the witness.
THE FLAG STORY (the collector's own annotations, as-reported): b = break in series (DE 2010/2011/2020, the German LFS redesigns), d = definition differs (FR and ES 2021-2025, the LFS 2021 questionnaire redesign — France's series is one continuous 2003-2025 line with a definitional seam riding quality_code, NOT a geo seam: FX does not exist in this dataset, probed empty). u/bu (low reliability) hit small states only, none on FR/DE. No 'e'/'p' in this cube.
THE BY-NATIONALITY DOOR (Le Destin des immigrés' Turks-and-Yugoslavs question, out of scope today): ILOSTAT's citizenship and place-of-born rate flows (DF_UNE_DEAP_SEX_AGE_CCT_RT / _CBR_RT, the ILMS family, verified live for FRA 2015-2018) are the future harmonized-tier door for exactly that question — recorded in sources.yaml with the probe fingerprint.
